notes.title: Another New Update has Arrived!
notes.notes:
[h1]The awesome witches has casted some amazing spells to the world of Furriend.
[/h1]

Now, you can enjoy the game even more with all of the updates we have made in the game, here're all of those updates.

[h3]Casted Spells (Change Log):
[list]
[*]Add encouragement words when progress reach 50%
[*]Add level complete screen when player complete the level
[*]Add Simplified Chinese & Traditional Chinese Localization
[*]Fixing all of the bugs we've discovered
[*]Update achievement icon
[/list][/h3]

So, come to the world full of magic once more and play with all of the witches and their beloved pawsome furriend.

[h3]Complete all of the pawzzle rituals again and summon even more pawsome companion, Furriend![/h3]
